# FrameGuard

FrameGuard is a local human-in-the-loop visual change-review demonstration for WebMCP.

## Agent behavior

- Inspect the document before proposing a change.
- Keep protected Logo and Legal elements unchanged.
- Present proposed changes visibly for human review.
- Never apply agent-selected changes without authorization in the FrameGuard UI.
- Keep exports local and secret-free.
